mask.definition: 255 iff semantic ID maps to the exact target_id class; 0 otherwise; no illumination gating, morphology, dilation or inferred pixels
mask.empty_target_mask: valid all-zero mask with pixels0 and luma/bbox null

bbox: xyxy inclusive, zero-based, null for empty mask

luma.encoding: saved display-referred RGB8 code values; no inverse gamma

visibility.rule: valid RGB AND pixels>=min_px AND (min_luma is null OR mean_luma>=min_luma)

legacy_unknown_policy: null plus explicit metadata_gaps; never synthesize missing timestamps, retry counts, versions or settings; normalized legacy export may pass format while strict new-capture metadata gate fails
invalid_rgb_policy: empty/malformed/spatially_uniform RGB is invalid; preserve original failure. All-black target mask alone is valid. Retry policy must be explicitly bound; PDF acquisition interval0.5s timeout30s does not authorize retry after DEVICE_LOST/fatal pagefault.
immutability: additive export only; source records, PNG, NPZ, labels, frozen manifests and old model responses are immutable
frame_association: one RGB/semantic/labels/target-mask set per route_id+frame_idx, same captured pose; T frames=actions+1 including initial and final frame
export_gate: format validator pass and all source/output SHA verified; strict metadata gate additionally required for newly acquired datasets; never silently relabel historical renderer or acquisition policy
